description: Defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for the Note API, including request and response structures.

classes.name: NoteDtos.CreateRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a new note, includes title and content with validation annotations.

classes.name: NoteDtos.UpdateRequest
classes.description: DTO for updating an existing note, includes title and content with validation annotations.

classes.name: NoteDtos.Response
classes.description: DTO representing the note response with id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt fields.

methods.name: NoteDtos.Response
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the response DTO with note details.
